body:
DECISION: D2 V11 is the accepted documentation contract and supersedes frozen V8/V9/V10.

Exact working-tree hashes:
- NARRATIVE_PROCESS_ALIGNMENT_NOTES.md = 5b42143aa37179ff7a63aa271ecb7f56161205c5cdd5d0e4dcf42660335ec410
- docs/plans/2026-08-29-movie-narrative-architecture.md = b482f9bcbd59ce109448e111be58d1130b3aadee2704c303cf9d48bde96067ed

Consensus:
1. Timestamp class is derived by operation, never caller tag.
2. Every identity derives from its complete canonical preimage; identity mismatch and receipt substitution refuse.
3. Every generic checked-construction door has a same-mechanism honest-control probe, and every refusal has a lawful positive control.
4. Derived content identity proves integrity, not extractor execution.
5. C1 packet outcomes are explicitly synthetic/fixture-scoped; pure exact rescaling remains portable.
6. Runtime decoder records remain draft through C1/D0/D1; D0 stays read-only and decoder-free.
7. Only separately authorized E0 may mint runtime packet/extractor provenance through an adapter-owned orchestrator-issued invocation/result plus append-only journal join.
8. Generic codec replay remains draft; forged-whole-receipt versus issued-receipt and lawful-join courts are mandatory.
9. No dependency, package, decoder, media access, provider, or runtime execution is authorized by this decision.

Independent component-ledger and video-admission reviews both ACCEPT exact V11 under the anti-dither blocker rule. Next action is immutable candidate review and chief authorization, not implementation.
